نذلولي (form XII)
# نَذْلَوْلِي (naḏlawlī) /nað.law.liː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِذْلَوْلَى (iḏlawlā)
# نَذْلَوْلِيَ (naḏlawliya) /nað.law.li.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِذْلَوْلَى (iḏlawlā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
